description: QuEra-style laser-lock recovery (F12, 99.3% autonomous relock). The controller's job is to DETECT and SHED load during recovery, not to relock the laser itself — the press's only quantitative case.

steps.note: shed load first; cannot lock into a hot gain medium
slowly restore gain; relock happens at physics layer

side_effects: press cites 99.3% autonomous relock at QuEra; this code file is reusable
